name: financial-statement-yearend
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint) statutory year-end financial-statement template (Notice to Reader / compilation register, CSRS 4200), deep-extracted from a real private compilation-template docx and a genuine PwC-audited PDF sample. Portrait letter, symmetric 1in margins, pure black-on-white — the audited Big-Four look. A sibling of financial-report-layout, not the same register (different geometry, density, and tone).

variants.name: cover
variants.description: Title block (entity 16pt / 'FINANCIAL STATEMENTS' 14pt / period), currency line, assurance-caveat box, draft/version stamp in a @top-right margin box on a named cover page (page-1 only).

variants.name: statement-financial-position
variants.description: Balance sheet — one continuous 3-column table (label 55% / value 22.5% / 22.5%, equal value-column widths).

variants.name: statement-equity
variants.description: Statement of changes in equity/partners' capital — 4- or 5-column stacked roll-forward (40/20x3 or 36/16x4).

variants.name: statement-cash-flow
variants.description: Statement of cash flows — same 3-column convention as financial-position.

variants.name: notes
variants.description: Note blocks (h4 10pt bold); the ONLY section carrying page numbers (@bottom-center "- N -"), per this bundle's own adopted-from-legal-agreements convention.

variants.name: signature-block
variants.description: Side-by-side drawn-rule signature table (hairline bottom border, not underscores), cells 44%/12%/44%.

aria: Statement tables use <table><caption> naming the statement and period; numeric cells right-aligned with tabular-nums, min-width 105px to prevent reflow-induced misreading. Running headers are implemented via CSS GCPM running()/element() — decorative to assistive tech (the entity/statement/currency info is already in the page's own heading structure), correctly excluded from the accessibility tree by the print engine.
motion: Print-first static document — no interaction states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint.
open_questions: oq-1: 10pt body size is inferred from the source docx, not explicitly extracted (no w:sz on the relevant style) — verify against a future source revision before treating as definitively final.

oq-2: page-number convention (@bottom-center "- N -", Notes section only) was deliberately adopted FROM this workspace's legal-agreement family rather than the PwC sample's own bare-digit/bottom-right convention — an intentional cross-family consistency choice, not an oversight.
